comment: Rules of the whole-install documentation sweep (coverage --sweep) and of the extraction of documentation outside doc/ in module jars. Read by tools/niagara_help_lib/install_rules.py; its docstring explains every key and the glob syntax.

skip_dirs.reason: bundled Java runtime (third-party; its API is the separate jdk/ index)
embedded Chromium browser runtime (third-party binaries, no jars)
a copy of this tool's own extracted corpus placed in the install, not shipped documentation

extract.reason: Markdown page or readme in a module's rc/ web resources (bajaScript-ux rc/env/bajaScriptCommunications.md: the BajaScript communications guide)
JSDoc API pages shipped in a module jar (EC-Net 4.3 batchJob-ux jsdoc/)
Workbench built-in pages: Help Contents, About and the error page
module help page outside doc/ (micros-wb help.html, micros-ux rc/html/altHelp.html)

exclude.reason: user-authored exam and review solutions, not official course material (reachable through research block B1354)
course slide / lab / reference PDF: its text is indexed from text/<same name>.txt (paired in the COURSE row)
certificate or key material of the code-signing labs: never indexed
build, HSM or signing configuration (keystore paths, jarsigner password placeholders): never indexed
Gradle build scripts and wrappers, module descriptors and permissions, lexicons, palettes, station and data files and build-tool scripts of the lab projects (the Java sources are indexed)
integrity manifests and zip listing of the course archive
lexicon of a jar outside modules/ (bin/ext daemon, sw/ software database, module copies at the install root): only the installed modules' lexicons are indexed (lexicon-text/)
jar metadata (META-INF/): manifests and the licence/notice texts of bundled libraries
licence, notice or copyright text (of the module or a bundled library)
bundled npm package (READMEs, changelogs and test pages of third-party JavaScript libraries)
bundled third-party library or SDK copied into a module's web resources
resource inside the Java package tree of a bundled third-party library (word lists, syntax help, package.html), not Niagara documentation
javadoc package description bundled with library classes (the Niagara API is indexed from the javadoc and .bajadoc)
Gradle templates of the new-module wizard (a 115-byte placeholder doc page, its toc.xml and repository settings), not documentation
Gradle templates of the new-module wizard in the local Maven repository (same placeholder pages as devkit-wb.jar)
example chart data, Px views and images of the kitControl palette (data files, no prose)
Haystack tag dictionary data tables (tag lists per equipment type), not prose
name lists for the HTTP client UI (HTTP header and media type names)
QUDT unit vocabulary data table used for OPC UA unit mapping
build version stamp of a bundled library
theme rendering test fixture (sample widgets, no prose)
HTML page of a module's web user interface (rc/ application markup that loads scripts), not documentation; a page named like help is never excluded by this rule
page asset (script, stylesheet, source map, image or font) of documentation-like folders; the pages that use it are indexed
frame and tree menu of the PDF documentation library (links to PDFs; this install ships none of them: welcome text only)

course.comment: The developer course bound to a version (registry course_dir): text/*.txt pages and the recordings/ transcripts (.txt, and .srt with their timestamps) -> course-text/ (indexed page by page), example code -> devguide-examples/course/; every other course file needs an exclude rule with jar "(course)".
